answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio.
